translations.processing.spatial.title: Spatial audio
translations.processing.spatial.info:
Headphones use the Aalto University near-field SOFA HRTF to render 7.1 audio.

Performance emphasizes directional clarity. Immersion adds diffuse room energy.

Distance moves from Close at 0, through neutral at 50, to Far at 100. Its level ranges from +2.5 dB to -2.5 dB.

Select surround output in the game and disable the game's own HRTF or DTS processing. LFE retains a direct bass path.

Speakers use a 7.1-to-stereo fold-down instead.
translations.processing.outputInfo:
Headphones add gentle low-frequency crossfeed for hard-panned stereo audio.

Speakers keep direct stereo.

This stereo option is not HRTF surround.
translations.processing.voice.title: Voice dynamics
translations.processing.smartVolume.title: Smart volume & boost
translations.processing.voice.info:
Noise gate silences signals below its threshold.

Compressor reduces loud peaks while keeping speech present.

Volume boost adjusts the final channel level.
translations.processing.smartVolume.info:
Smart volume balances quiet and loud audio automatically.

Volume boost adjusts the final channel level.
translations.processing.limiter.info: Prevents volume boost and dynamics processing from exceeding the selected ceiling and clipping.

translations.onboarding.setup.title: Build your audio setup
translations.onboarding.setup.body: Channels keep game, chat and media separate. Set their levels and outputs in Mixer, and create mixes when OBS or another recorder needs its own feed.
translations.onboarding.apps.title: Route games and apps
translations.onboarding.apps.body: Open Apps or drag a running app onto a Mixer channel. Sonux remembers where that app belongs the next time it starts.
translations.onboarding.profiles.title: Keep complete profiles
translations.onboarding.profiles.body: Profiles remember channels, levels, routing, outputs, EQ, mixes and microphone settings. Manage them on Profiles, and optionally link a game or app to activate one automatically.
translations.onboarding.microphone.title: Process your microphone
translations.onboarding.microphone.body: Optional: shape your mic with a noise gate, compressor and limiter. Then choose the Sonux microphone in Discord, OBS or another voice app.
translations.onboarding.replay.title: That's the tour
translations.onboarding.replay.body: Channels, apps, profiles and the mic are all live - your setup is untouched.
translations.onboarding.choice.title: How do you want to start?
